subject: MSA / DPA / SOW Redlines — Pivot Analytics integration
messages:
From: Hector Ruiz <hector@pivotanalytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@maya-consulting.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pivot integration — initial MSA/DPA/SOW for review

Sergio,

Great to connect last week — as discussed, attaching our standard MSA, DPA and a draft SOW for the integration work (attachments). Procurement at Pivot asked us to get legal alignment before the technical kickoff. High level asks from our side:

- Please review the MSA and propose any redlines. Key items for us are: audit rights, IP carveouts for delivered connectors, and 60-day payment terms.
- DPA: we included our required security appendix; please confirm compatibility with Redwood's data handling.
- SOW: timeline target is kickoff first week of August and delivery of v1 connector by end of September.

For efficiency, we usually route contracts through Maya Consulting (cc'd) for legal intake. If you can send an initial counter-redline, we can loop in our GC.

Attachments: Pivot_MSA_v2_redline.pdf (redline), SOW_Pivot_Integration_v1.docx, DPA_clean.pdf.

Thanks,

Hector Ruiz
Head of Partnerships
Pivot Analytics
hector@pivotanalytics.com

On Fri, Jul 25, 2025 at 08:55 AM, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Hector — got the docs and will coordinate with our legal and procurement teams.
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Hector Ruiz <hector@pivotanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, contracts@maya-consulting.com
Date: Sat, 26 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pivot integration — initial MSA/DPA/SOW for review

Hector — thanks for sharing. Looping in Laura (legal) and Evelyn (procurement) to review the attachments. Quick summary of Redwood's initial positions below so we can be aligned before formal redline exchange:

1) Liability cap: Redwood typically proposes the greater of (i) three times fees paid in prior 12 months or (ii) $1,000,000. We note your draft has an uncapped/very high liability exposure; please let us know if Pivot can accept a commercially customary cap.

2) Indemnity: we ask for mutual narrow indemnities limited to direct claims and excluding indirect/ consequential damages.

3) Data/DPA: Our preferred DPA includes standard deletion and data segregation obligations, and a SOC2 evidence handoff in lieu of on-site audits unless scoped and paid for separately.

4) Payment terms: Redwood normally runs Net30. If Pivot requires extended terms (Net60), procurement needs an explanation — Evelyn, can you advise tolerance for Net45/Net60 on new partners?

5) SOW: timeline looks achievable; we'll propose more explicit milestones and acceptance criteria so deliverables are not ambiguous.

I'll prepare an internal redline and send a single consolidated file back to you Monday. If there's anything urgent for the kickoff scheduling please flag.

Best,

Sergio Alvarez
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Laura and Evelyn, tagging you for legal/procurement review.
From: Hector Ruiz <hector@pivotanalytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@maya-consulting.com
Date: Sun, 27 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pivot integration — initial MSA/DPA/SOW for review

Appreciate the quick reply, Sergio. A few responses after a quick skim and upstream GC consult: 

- Liability cap: Pivot can accept a cap, but our finance team prefers $2,000,000 for this engagement based on expected ARR and risk profile. Would Redwood consider $2M rather than your suggested $1M/3x-fees?
- Payment terms: We can consider Net45 as a compromise between Net30 and Net60.
- Audits: We need the ability to request SOC2 reports and reasonable cooperation for security questionnaires. On-site audits would be exceptional and scoped/paid separately.
- IP: We need assurance that Pivot can use the delivered connector and related configuration data; we are fine with Redwood owning the core model but want rights to use and redistribute the connector code we contribute.

Attached a quick counter-redline (Pivot_counter_MSA.pdf). Also, can you confirm whether Redwood's standard DPA permits subprocessors for cloud hosting? That will determine whether we need an addendum.

If we can align on liability cap and payment terms this week, our GC is ready to schedule an official DocuSign route early next week.

Regards,
Hector

--
Attachments: Pivot_counter_MSA.pdf
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Hector Ruiz <hector@pivotanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, contracts@maya-consulting.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pivot integration — initial MSA/DPA/SOW for review

Hector — thanks. I discussed the counter-points with Legal (Laura) and Procurement (Evelyn). Summary and proposed path forward: 

- Liability cap: Redwood legal is amenable to moving to a $2,000,000 cap for this specific integration given Pivot's size and the strategic nature of the partnership. We'll reflect that in the redline.

- Payment terms: Procurement prefers Net30 as default; however, for a first-year pilot we can accept Net45. Evelyn will prepare a one-year payment memo and track the impact to cashflow.

- Audits & SOC2: Redwood can provide the latest SOC2 report and grant typical security questionnaire cooperation. On-site audits are reserved for material concerns and would be scoped/paid separately — we can add that language.

- IP / Connector code: We agree to grant Pivot a limited license to use and redistribute the connector code delivered under the SOW, subject to Redwood's license grant language (we will add a specific clause in the SOW). Laura will send exact language in the redline.

Next steps: Laura and I will circulate a consolidated redline (MSA + DPA + SOW) this afternoon. If that looks good to Pivot, we can route via DocuSign (link below) and aim for signatures by Thu 07/31 to keep the kickoff on schedule. After signatures we'll finalize the SOW milestones and set a kickoff for the week of Aug 11.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://docusign.com/sea/XYZ-12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890

Thanks everyone — appreciate the responsiveness.

Best,
